newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 7.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The vice-director of the State Commission for Economic Restructuring said China would further push forward the work of transforming state-owned enterprises into shareholding companies.
- the price earnings ratio on China's stock markets has risen much more quickly than the listed companies' earnings per share, indicating an increase of risk which investors should note.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai's achievements in the process of reforming state-owned enterprises is highly regarded by the State Commission for Economic Restructuring.
- Shanghai's gross domestic product was 26.582 billion yuan in April, up 15.6 percent over the same period last year, while the retail price index was 98.9 in April, down year-on-year 1.1 percent.
